paraphrase: Now I shall explain the secret, briefly and not at length: the union with Śrī Heruka, which accomplishes all desired aims.
notes: Reference from memory; not located in a local text. (Laghuśaṃvara 1.1).

paraphrase: The twenty-four sites of the Heruka maṇḍala are named — among them Pullīramalaya, Jālandhara, Oḍḍiyāna, Arbuda, Godāvarī, Rāmeśvara, Devīkoṭa, Mālava, Kāmarūpa, Oḍra, Triśakuni, Kośala, Kaliṅga, Lampāka, Kāñcī, Himālaya, Pretapurī, Gṛhadevatā, Saurāṣṭra, Suvarṇadvīpa, Nagara, Sindhu, Maru and Kulatā — arranged in the wheels of mind, speech and body, each with its ḍāka and yoginī, and (in the commentaries) mapped onto the body.
notes: Reference from memory; not located in a local text. Chapter not recalled; the list follows the common Tibetan/Sanskrit order as remembered.
